title: Chicken madras with green beans
summary: Chicken madras with green beans is a indian dinner built around skinless chicken breast fillets and green beans, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chicken madras with green beans. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add skinless chicken breast fillets and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and green beans.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chicken madras with green beans before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chicken madras with green beans.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
